verdict.rationale: Anytype has no documented built-in AI that produces insights or suggestions. AI analysis of your data requires external tools: the official MCP server and the Agents Skill let assistants like Claude Code or Cursor read, search, and modify Objects through the local API. Queries and the Graph surface connections, but they are criteria-based and visual, not AI-generated. Missing for 10: native in-app AI insights or suggestions, any AI feature that runs inside the Anytype UI without third-party assistants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
